Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/11/Text/7] The result in Fig. 2 shows that the 4 groups differed significantly in all the five adolescent quality of life indicators at time 2. The SC-Improved and the Quality Selves had statistically the lowest deviant behavior, the same highest scores in achievement, time management, number of friends. They differed only in that the Quality Selves had higher sense of life satisfaction than the SC-Improved. The Disadvantageous and the Lower Baseline had statistically the same lowest scores in achievement, number of friends, time management, and life satisfaction.
